title: Splitting off the first exterior Koszul generator
statement: For every commutative ring A, r natural and list a : Fin (r+1) → A, the reindexed exterior Koszul complex K_m(a) of [def-weil-pbc-intrinsic-completion] is isomorphic to Tot(K_m(a_0) tensor_A K_m(tail)), where tail(i)=a(i.succ) and all powers have exponent m+1. Isomorphisms may be chosen for all m so that the exterior diagonal transition commutes with the tensor of the first and tail exterior transitions, and the exterior degree-zero unit of [def-weil-pbc-finite-negative-koszul-tensor] maps to the tensor of those two units in summand (0,0). No scheme, scalar extension, or dualization occurs.

source.place: Tag 0664, lemma-join-sequences-koszul-complex, the decomposition by the ordered first generator.

proof.text: Use the explicitly constructed exterior multiplication on each tensor summand. Its local Leibniz equation assembles through the coproduct universal property into a chain map from the head-tail total tensor to the full Koszul complex.

The graded multiplication maps are bijective, so this chain map is an isomorphism. Exterior generator scaling commutes with the two inclusions and with multiplication; this proves its strict compatibility with every power transition. The product of the empty exterior wedges proves the degree-zero unit equation. Inverting the chain maps gives the asserted orientation and both compatibility equations.

from.place: The finite Koszul model of derived completion in def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback; Tag 0A0E identifies the negative finite complex with the dual of the positive one. This node isolates splitting off the first exterior koszul generator.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulAdjoinGenerator
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (a : Fin (r + 1) → A) :
    ∃ e : ∀ m : ℕ, completedKoszulPower (A := A) (r + 1) a m ≅
        HomologicalComplex.tensorObj
          (completedKoszulPower (A := A) 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m)
          (completedKoszulPower (A := A) r (fun i ↦ a i.succ) m),
      (∀ m, completedKoszulTransition (A := A) (r + 1) a m ≫ (e m).hom =
        (e (m + 1)).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.tensorHom
          (completedKoszulTransition (A := A) 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m)
          (completedKoszulTransition (A := A) r (fun i ↦ a i.succ) m)) ∧
      (∀ m, finiteKoszulExteriorUnitZero (r + 1) a m ≫ (e m).hom.f 0 =
        (ρ_ (ModuleCat.of A A)).inv ≫
          (finiteKoszulExteriorUnitZero 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m ⊗ₘ
            finiteKoszulExteriorUnitZero r (fun i ↦ a i.succ) m) ≫
          HomologicalComplex.ιTensorObj
            (completedKoszulPower (A := A) 1 (fun _ ↦ a 0) m)
            (completedKoszulPower (A := A) r (fun i ↦ a i.succ) m) 0 0 0 (by omega))
